entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the material brought on record.

3. This first bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused in Case Crime No.21 of 2024,
under Sections - 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Dholna,
District- Kasganj with the prayer to enlarge the applicant-accused on bail.
4. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place on 22.06.2023.

The allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled against the Deepak vs State Of U.P. on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175811870/
1 applicant are wholly false.
In postmortem report, except ligature mark, no other injury has been shown on body of deceased and cause of death is ante-mortem hanging.
Learned counsel has submitted that in his cross-examination, informant/ PW-1 Sachin Kumar has not supported prosecution version and turned hostile.
Lastly, it was stated that the applicant is in jail since 11.02.2024 and that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
5. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and that deceased has suffered death due to hanging within seven years of her marriage.
6. Perusal of record shows that applicant is husband of deceased and their marriage has taken place only about seven months prior to the incident.
There are allegations that the deceased was being harassed on account of dowry.
As per prosecution version, only one day before of the incident, the deceased has told that she was continuously being harassed by applicant and co-accused persons.
There are serious allegations in the first information report.
In examination-in-chief, PW-1 has supported prosecution version but during cross-examination he has back-tracked from that version.
Some material witnesses are yet to be examined before the trial Court.

7. Considering submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of detention and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, no case for bail is made out at this stage.
8. The bail application is hereby rejected.
